{{wiktionary|Meiji|meiji}}
'''Meiji''', the romanization of the Japanese characters 明治, may refer to:

==Japanese history==
* {{ill|Emperor Meiji|en|Emperor Meiji|qid=Q174231|lt=Emperor Meiji|1=Emperor Meiji}}, Emperor of Japan between 1867 and 1912
** {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era|1=Meiji era}}, the name given to that period in Japanese history
*** [[Meiji Restoration]], the revolution that began the Meiji period
*** {{ill|Meiji Constitution|en|Meiji Constitution|qid=Q122804|lt=Meiji Constitution|1=Meiji Constitution}}, the constitution of the Empire of Japan between 1890 and 1947
** [[Meiji Shrines]]

, a Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji and his wife

==Other uses==

* {{ill|Meiji Holdings|en|Meiji Holdings|qid=Q11512295|lt=Meiji Holdings|1=Meiji Holdings}}, a Japanese food and pharmaceutical holding company
** [[:en:Meiji (company)|Meiji (company)]], a Japanese food company
** {{ill|Meiji Seika Pharma|en|Meiji Seika Pharma|qid=Q11232923|lt=Meiji Seika Pharma|1=Meiji Seika Pharma}}, a Japanese pharmaceutical company
* {{ill|Meiji-mura|en|Meiji-mura|qid=Q985290|lt=Meiji-mura|1=Meiji-mura}}, an open-air architectural museum near Nagoya, Japan
* {{ill|Meiji Seamount|en|Meiji Seamount|qid=Q3298600|lt=Meiji Seamount|1=Meiji Seamount}}, a seamount (underwater mountain) in the northern Pacific Ocean
* Meiji Senmon Gakkou, the former name of the {{ill|Kyushu Institute of Technology|en|Kyushu Institute of Technology|qid=Q1150245|lt=Kyushu Institute of Technology|1=Kyushu Institute of Technology}}
* {{ill|Meiji University|en|Meiji University|qid=Q46492|lt=Meiji University|1=Meiji University}}, a university in Tokyo, Japan
* {{ill|Meiji Yasuda Life|en|Meiji Yasuda Life|qid=Q174081|lt=Meiji Yasuda Life|1=Meiji Yasuda Life}}, a Japanese life insurance company
